rationale: No supported optimization fits this workflow without violating its stated intent or lacking prerequisites. Both matrix jobs explicitly set fail-fast: false with comments that all combinations must run regardless of failure; P-LIT-FAIL-FAST lists 'Every matrix outcome is required' and 'Full failure diagnostics are required' as contraindications, so enabling fail-fast would remove required coverage. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE has no visible dependency-installation steps in the workflow to cache, and its preconditions (measurable repeated dependency fetching, lockfile/environment cache inputs) are not evidenced. History-based optimizations (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT) require representative successful-duration history, but the repository CI history reports no completed runs and no measured baseline. Trigger/path-filtering patterns are poorly suited to a reusable workflow_call workflow with no push/pull_request triggers.
